arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) AS cards_with_same_timestamp_pair FROM (SELECT card_id, date FROM transactions GROUP BY card_id, date HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)
arguments.explanation: Counts the distinct cards that have at least one timestamp shared by two or more of their transactions.
assumptions: Same timestamp means identical date value (to the second) on the same card_id.
All transactions count, including those with no fraud label and those with negative amounts.
